title: Angels Created by God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Angels are created spiritual beings made by God to serve His purposes. They are not divine, not equal with God, and not to be worshiped, but exist under His authority and command.
summary: Angels are created spiritual beings made by God to serve His purposes. They are not divine, not equal with God, and not to be worshiped, but exist under His authority and command.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is greater than the angels. Angels worship Him, serve around His redemptive mission, and remain subject to His authority as the eternal Son of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that angels are real, created beings. They are part of the unseen realm God made, and they exist because He commanded and created them. They are powerful, but they are not eternal, self-existent, or divine.

Angels serve God’s will. They worship before Him, carry out His commands, minister according to His purpose, and appear in Scripture at key moments in God’s redemptive work. Their greatness should lead believers to worship God, not angels.

The Bible also makes clear that angels must not be worshiped. When John fell before an angel, he was corrected and told to worship God. Even holy angels direct attention away from themselves and toward the Lord.

Christ is superior to angels. He is not one angel among many, nor the highest created being. He is the eternal Son through whom all things were made, including angels. They worship Him, and His name, authority, and glory are above theirs.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People can fall into two errors regarding angels: ignoring what Scripture says about them, or becoming fascinated with them in a way that distracts from God. Angels are real, but they are not the center of faith.

This doctrine keeps believers grounded. The unseen realm is real, but God alone is to be worshiped. Angels are servants under God’s authority, and Christ is supreme over every created power.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Give thanks that God rules over both the visible and invisible realms. Do not pray to angels, seek guidance from angels, or treat angels as spiritual objects of trust. Worship God alone, honor Christ as supreme over all creation, and receive Scripture’s teaching with reverence and restraint.
